text:
Mira Patel: Morning triage — quick check. Queue at 09:15: 42 tickets total, 7 high priority (billing x2, embeds webhook x3, degraded routing x2). Known issue: embeddings webhook returning 503s/timeouts for several customers behind Cloudflare. I've tagged impacted tickets with #embeds-503 and pushed a small macro update draft. Please read below and call dibs on tickets.

Alex Chen: Taking a look — I'll pick up ticket #3421 (customer: Acme). Any recent deploys or config changes?

support-bot: alert • 09:06 UTC • embeds-webhook-503 spike across eu-west/ap-southeast. Avg 503 rate 18% over 15m. Dashboard: https://redwood.internal/alerts/embeds-503 (bot)

Juan Gomez: Pushed a micro tweak to the macro to request logs + sample payloads. Snippet:
```
Macro: embeds_retry_v2
- ask customer for sample payload + timestamp
- request: curl -v https://api.redwood/example -H 'Authorization: ...'
- collect gateway logs (cloudflare edge id)
```

Sam Lee: I'll run regional synthetic probes now and report results. Also pinging @eng-runtime in case we need to look at kernel selection or fallback routing. Quick CR ping: PR #789 touches the macro UI — @Mira can you review when free?

Mira Patel: @Sam thanks. I'll review PR #789 today EOD. For immediate mitigation, please consider toggling fallback routing so affected customers hit the "embeds-legacy" variant if 503 rate > 10% for >10m. Add that to macros as an optional step. Also escalate any paying customers in SSO orgs.

Priya Nair: FYI — ticket volume spike correlates with docs change deployed 08:30 (new rate limits example). I've drafted an outbound macro message (short apology + mitigation steps) queued for review. If approved I can send to impacted customers.

Alex Chen: Repro steps added to #3421, starting collection of collector logs. If I can't reproduce in 30m I'll escalate to eng-runtime and include the cloudflare edge ids. ETA 2h on root-cause initial triage.

Sam Lee: Probe results: us-west nominal, eu-west returning 503s between 08:40-09:05 (~22% of calls), ap-southeast intermittent timeouts. Uploaded logs gist: https://gist.github.com/redwood/placeholder (sensitive redacted). :eyes:

Mira Patel: Thanks all. Action items summary: 1) Alex — debug #3421 / collect logs / escalate if repro fails. 2) Sam — run fallback routing to embeds-legacy for impacted customers and post results. 3) Priya — finalize macro outbound message and hold for approval. 4) @eng-runtime — standby for logs and repro help. I'll check back in 1h — if anything critical pops, ping this thread or call 1:1.

support-bot: Reminder • next async triage summary posted at 12:00 UTC. Current quick snapshot: high=7, medium=20, low=15.
